critical_code_review_comments: server.py L8006-8092 correctly strips pain_reported/pain_note for non-attention ratings BEFORE computing needs_coach_review, so smooth_flight + pain_reported=true yields needs_coach_review=false. Verified by Test 5.
coach_tasks summary is built from reasons + optional 'Pain location: <note>' + optional 'Note: "<180 chars>"'. Contains 'Heavy turbulence' / 'Reported pain' / '<note>' as required by Tests 2/3/4.

PostWorkoutRatingSheet.tsx pw-log uses aria-disabled (not the DOM disabled attribute) — Playwright's is_disabled() would miss it. Verified via aria-disabled attribute + opacity check. Test authors should use aria-disabled for future assertions.
workout/[id]/index.tsx complete() correctly opens the sheet FIRST and defers the /complete call until the sheet's onSubmit — no double-fire risk.
Confirm card text 'Nice work — logged.' matches spec exactly; BACK TO DASHBOARD label present on pw-confirm-done.
